Title: Batch delivery in Azure Event Grid for high-throughput scenarios now in preview

Body.Content:
Event subscriptions in Azure Event Grid now support batching semantics, which allows for more efficient publishing at large volumes and greater throughput. Event subscriptions with batching enabled can configure a max event count or a match batch size (in kb).

Learn more in docs
